decisions.reason: As a renamed successor to an already well-liked trommel screen, Product A now carries accumulated market legitimacy and sunk investment, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it.
The multi-model mobile flail shredder line reflects substantial development effort and public commitment and fits the firm's mobile recycling portfolio, which favors continuing with it.

Although less prominently presented than some other launches, the mobile high-speed grinder line has now been carried for several years and remains aligned with the firm's announced technical-development direction, making continuation more likely than exit.

This green-waste-focused grinder line is a narrower extension and therefore somewhat more vulnerable, but prior investment, strategic fit, and the tendency to explain any weakness by market-specific conditions support keeping it.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line signals strong commitment through its dedicated presentation and multiple models, and management would tend to persist with it as part of a broader resource-saving processing portfolio.
